lead: Competitive intelligence across aviation EFB, dispatch, and flight operations vendors reveals active customer acquisition and platform updates. Vendors such as IFS, Aviobook, Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, and Navblue secured notable airline agreements while expanding mobile and integrated software capabilities.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc adopts AvioBook Flight EFB
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilot fleet with the AvioBook Flight Electronic Flight Bag platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service network carrier, utilizing EFB platforms for cockpit digitization.
insights.caveat: Captured via a LinkedIn announcement; exact deployment milestones are not detailed.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple EFB wins including LCC and regional operators
insights.finding: IFS secured customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform from fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an LCC, MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Announcements highlight selection and deployment phases but do not quantify long-term operational metrics.

insights.title: Jeppesen launches ForeFlight Airflow and expands mobile support
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced Airflow to incorporate artificial intelligence into flight operations alongside version updates for FliteDeck Pro and OzRunways.
insights.aviation_context: Enhancements target commercial flight crew workflows and hardware integration.
insights.caveat: Feature sets are described in press and product releases without independent performance verification.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems updates Lido mPilot and deploys Lido Flight 4D
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3 with aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions and deployed Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways.
insights.aviation_context: Lido Flight 4D provides flight planning and digital briefing, while mPilot supplies electronic aeronautical charts.

insights.title: Navblue expands TransNusa collaboration on Skywise portfolio
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue to adopt Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ for integrated flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Integration links real-time fleet health monitoring with flight operations.
insights.caveat: Derived from press releases and LinkedIn captures regarding new product adoption.
